en: I've studied Slowpoke all my life, and I still can't tell you what they're thinking.
They say a Slowpoke bitten on the head by a Shellder becomes wise. Here, I found this down here. Take it.
Let a Slowpoke hold the King's Rock when you trade it, and something remarkable may happen.
A King's Rock can make a foe flinch now and then. A small crown with a big effect.
